einvoice.headline: E-Invoice: Outgoing Invoices
einvoice.intro: Since 2025-01-01, companies in Germany are required to be able to receive e-invoices. Sending becomes mandatory in stages (fully by 2028). Configure which format is generated for your outgoing invoices.
einvoice.help_off: Only the classic PDF invoice from the LaTeX template is generated. As of 2025, companies are obliged to be able to receive e-invoices — plain PDFs are usually no longer sufficient for business recipients. Only suitable for invoices to end consumers.
einvoice.help_zugferd: Recommended standard for B2B in Germany. Creates a hybrid invoice: a PDF/A-3 readable by humans with an embedded XML file (factur-x.xml) in the EN 16931 Extended profile. Accepted by every modern accounting system and kivitendo-compatible.
einvoice.help_zugferd_test: Same format as production ZUGFeRD, but flagged as a test invoice in the XML. Receiving systems will not process it as a real invoice. Useful for initial acceptance tests with new customers or for verifying your own configuration.
einvoice.help_xrechnung: Pure XML without PDF, in XRechnung 3.0 format (CIUS of EN 16931). Mandatory for invoices to public authorities (federal, state, municipal) in Germany. Requires a routing ID (Leitweg-ID) per recipient — maintain this in the customer master data under "Our routing ID at customer". Delivery via email or administrative portals (e.g. ZRE, OZG-RE).
einvoice.help_xrechnung_test: Same format as production XRechnung, but flagged as a test invoice. Used for initial acceptance tests with authority receiving portals. Not booked as a real invoice.
einvoice.bank_hint: In the "SEPA/Bank" tab, at least one bank account must be marked "Use for Factur-X/ZUGFeRD". Otherwise IBAN and BIC will be empty in the generated XML.
einvoice.vatid_ok: VAT ID is set — required field BT-31 will be populated.
einvoice.vatid_missing: VAT ID is missing. Without it, the generated e-invoice will be rejected by the receiving system. Add it in the "Company" tab.
einvoice.leitweg_hint: For XRechnung, every customer needs an individual routing ID (Leitweg-ID). Maintain it in the customer master data under "Our routing ID at customer" (field c_vendor_routing_id).

datevExportFormatHelp: DATEV expects Western European character encoding (LATIN-1, cp1252). The "Strict with Abort" setting does not allow non-encodable characters in the DATEV export and aborts it with an error message. crm_fields.wallDisplayEnabled_help:
Enables the wall display feature for a large screen (e.g. 65" TV on the wall). Setup:

1. Create a regular user (e.g. "Display")
2. Go to user configuration → Startup view → select "Wall display"
3. Open the browser on the display in kiosk mode: chromium --kiosk http://your-address:5173
4. After login the display automatically shows the calendar

When an employee clicks the monitor icon in an invoice/order, the display switches to the document view (positions, customer, vehicle). Ideal for showing the order to the customer.
crm_fields.wallDisplaySize_help:
Controls the size of UI elements and fonts on the wall display.

• Auto: landscape screens (TV) get the compact rendering, portrait screens (wall tablet) the large one.
• Compact: small toolbar and fonts so the calendar fills as much space as possible — best for TVs.
• Normal: FullCalendar default sizes.
• Large: deliberately large fonts and buttons, readable from a few meters away — ideal for portrait wall tablets.

crm_fields.dhlApiKey_help: API key from the DHL Developer Portal (developer.dhl.com)
crm_fields.dhlUser_help: Username from the DHL business customer contract (Basic Auth)
crm_fields.dhlPassword_help: Password from the DHL business customer contract (Basic Auth)
crm_fields.dhlBillingNumber_help: 14-digit DHL billing number (EKP + product code + participation). Sandbox: 22222222220101
crm_fields.dhlDefaultProduct_help: DHL product that is preselected by default in the shipping dialog
crm_fields.dhlLabelFormat_help: Shipping label format. 103x199mm for label printers, A4 for standard printers.
crm_fields.dhlShipperName_help: Sender company name on the shipping label
crm_fields.dhlShipperCountry_help: Country code in ISO-3166-1 Alpha-3 format (e.g. DEU, AUT, CHE)
crm_fields.telegramEnabled_help: Enable Telegram messaging. Requires a Telegram bot (create one for free via the 'BotFather' bot in Telegram).
crm_fields.telegramBotToken_help: API token of the Telegram bot. Obtain it via the 'BotFather' bot in Telegram (message: /newbot). Format: 123456789:ABCdefGHIjklMNOpqrsTUVwxyz
crm_fields.telegramBotUsername_help: Username of the bot without the @ sign (e.g. MyCarShopBot). Customers reach the bot via t.me/MyCarShopBot
crm_fields.telegramWebhookSecret_help: A self-chosen secret word to secure the webhook. Ensures that only Telegram can send messages to your system.
crm_fields.lxcarsHuTriggerDescriptions_help: Comma-separated list of line item descriptions. If a line item contains one of these terms (substring, case-insensitive), the vehicle's next inspection date is automatically set to today + 2 years (1st of the month) when the invoice is created.
crm_fields.wallDisplayControllers_help: Logins of users who can control the wall display from the regular calendar (comma-separated, e.g. ronny,admin).
crm_fields.ebayEnabled_help: Enables automatic import of eBay orders as sales invoices (via cron every 15 minutes).
crm_fields.ebayEnvironment_help: Production = live eBay API. Sandbox = eBay test system for setup.
crm_fields.ebayMarketplaceId_help: eBay marketplace id, e.g. EBAY_DE for eBay Germany.
crm_fields.ebayClientId_help: OAuth client id from your eBay developer account (Application Keys).
crm_fields.ebayClientSecret_help: OAuth client secret from your eBay developer account.
crm_fields.ebayRefreshToken_help: Long-lived OAuth refresh token (scope sell.fulfillment) used to fetch orders.
crm_fields.ebayDefaultPartsId_help: Part id (parts.id) used for eBay line items without an SKU match and for shipping. Determines revenue/tax account via its booking group.
crm_fields.ebayEmployeeLogin_help: Login of the employee the eBay invoices are assigned to. Empty = first employee.

ebayPanelUi.title: eBay order import
ebayPanelUi.description: Fetch orders, test the connection and review the most recently imported documents. Regular fetching runs automatically via cron.
ebayPanelUi.disabled: eBay integration is not enabled. Enable it above and save the credentials.

crm_fields.ebayListingEnabled_help: Shows the image upload and the “eBay article” checkbox in the article editor.
crm_fields.ebayCategoryId_help: eBay category id articles are listed into (from the eBay category tree).
crm_fields.ebayPaymentPolicy_help: eBay business policy id for payment (seller account → business policies).
crm_fields.ebayReturnPolicy_help: eBay business policy id for returns.
crm_fields.ebayFulfillmentPolicy_help: eBay business policy id for shipping/fulfillment.
crm_fields.ebayLocationKey_help: merchantLocationKey of the eBay inventory location.
crm_fields.ebayListingQuantity_help: Quantity reported as available per article on eBay (default 1).

ebayArticle.title: eBay article
ebayArticle.noImages: No images yet. eBay requires at least one image.
ebayArticle.needImageHint: Please upload at least one image first.

add_fields.title: System Settings
add_fields.description: Manage basic system settings such as posting groups, tax zones, tax rates and bank accounts. Click on a section to view existing entries or create new ones.

buchungsgruppen.title: Posting Groups
buchungsgruppen.description: Posting groups define which revenue and expense accounts as well as inventory accounts are used for items. They are the basis for automatic posting creation.

taxzones.title: Tax Zones
taxzones.description: Tax zones define different tax regions (e.g. domestic, EU, third country) with individual revenue and expense accounts per tax rate.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: Manage tax rates (VAT, input tax) with associated tax accounts and keys for financial accounting.

bank_accounts.title: Bank Accounts
bank_accounts.description: Record your bank connections with IBAN, BIC and the associated GL account for payment transactions and account statement reconciliation.

buchungsgruppe.delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete this posting group?

taxzone.delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete this tax zone?
taxzone.used_warning: This tax zone is already in use and cannot be modified.

tax.taxkey_zero_only_for_rate_zero: Tax key 0 is reserved for rate 0
tax.rate_between_0_and_100: Tax rate must be between 0 and 100
tax.delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete this tax?

bank_account.name: Name
bank_account.iban_help: International Bank Account Number. The IBAN is automatically validated.
bank_account.iban_invalid_format: IBAN must start with 2 letters and 2 digits
bank_account.iban_invalid_country_length: IBAN has wrong length for this country
bank_account.qr_iban_help: Special IBAN for QR-invoices in Switzerland (starts with 'CH' + check digit 30 or 31)
bank_account.bank_account_id_help: Swiss bank account number (BC number) for QR-invoices
bank_account.chart_id_help: The general ledger account where bank transactions will be posted (e.g. 1200 Bank)
bank_account.use_with_bank_import_help: This bank account can be selected when importing bank statements (MT940, CAMT, CSV)
bank_account.use_for_zugferd_help: This bank account will be included in Factur-X/ZUGFeRD invoices as payment recipient
bank_account.use_for_qrbill_help: This bank account will be used for generating QR-invoices (Switzerland)
bank_account.reconciliation_starting_date_help: Date of the last bank statement from which reconciliation starts
bank_account.reconciliation_starting_balance_help: Account balance according to last bank statement on starting date
bank_account.delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete this bank account?

anpr.actionType_help: Info bar: Recognition is shown in the info bar. Actuator: Linked gate/barrier is controlled. Both: Info bar + Actuator
anpr.blacklist_help: Comma-separated list of plates to ignore (e.g. employees, residents). Example: B-AB1234, HH-XY567
anpr.calibrationHelp: Enter the gate height in cm and the pixel positions of the gate top and bottom edge in the camera image once. This allows the vehicle height to be calculated precisely.
anpr.cameraName_help: Freely chosen name for identification (e.g. Entrance, Workshop gate)
anpr.cameraPosition_help: Mounting position of the camera relative to the road surface. Affects licence plate recognition and height estimation
anpr.cooldownMinutes_help: Wait time after a report before the same plate is reported again
anpr.detectionTtlHours_help: How long a detection remains visible in the info bar
anpr.directionMode_help: Size: Entry is detected when the plate gets larger in the image. Position: Detection based on Y-movement in the image
anpr.enabled_help: Enable licence plate recognition at the workshop entrance
anpr.frameInterval_help: Time interval between two analyses. Smaller = more accurate but more CPU load. Recommended: 0.5 s
anpr.gateHeightMode_help: Open fully: Gate always opens completely. Vehicle height + buffer: Gate opens only as far as needed for the vehicle (saves energy, requires calibration)
anpr.hwCoralTooltip: Google Coral USB Accelerator (~€35) is a USB stick with an AI chip. When plugged in, it takes over object detection (~100 inferences/s). The CPU is thereby almost completely relieved. Coral accelerates object detection (NVR), NOT licence plate recognition (ANPR). For ANPR → use OpenVINO.
anpr.hwCpuTooltip: Server processor. Intel chips have an integrated GPU (iGPU) that can be used for AI acceleration.
anpr.hwIgpuTooltip: Intel processors have an integrated graphics card (UHD/Iris). This can accelerate licence plate recognition ~3x — for free, without additional hardware. Activation: install OpenVINO.
anpr.hwInstallSuccess: {pkg} was installed successfully. Restart the service to activate acceleration.
anpr.hwOpenvinoTooltip: Intel OpenVINO moves AI calculations from the CPU to the integrated Intel GPU. PaddleOCR (licence plate recognition) and YOLO (object detection) become ~3x faster. Installation: one click on 'Install'.
anpr.hwRecommendCoralDriver: Google Coral USB is plugged in but driver is missing. Click 'Install' to activate it.
anpr.hwRecommendOk: OpenVINO is active — PaddleOCR uses the Intel iGPU for accelerated licence plate recognition.
anpr.hwRecommendOpenvino: Recommendation: Your Intel processor has an integrated GPU. Install OpenVINO to accelerate licence plate recognition ~3x — for free, one click.
anpr.infobarMax_help: Maximum number of simultaneously displayed ANPR detections
anpr.linkedActuator_help: Gate or barrier that is automatically controlled when a known plate is recognised
anpr.minConfidence_help: Minimum detection confidence (0-1). Values below this threshold are ignored. Recommended: 0.60
anpr.minDetections_help: How many times a plate must be detected before it is reported. Prevents false detections. Recommended: 3
anpr.restartFailed: ANPR service could not be started
anpr.rtspUrl_help: RTSP address of the camera. Format: rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/PATH — with authentication, user and password come before the hostname separated by @. Find the path in the camera manual (often /av0_0 or /stream1)
anpr.serviceHost_help: IP address of the ANPR service (default: 127.0.0.1)
anpr.showUnknownVehicles_help: Also show vehicles that are not in the database
anpr.streamError: Stream could not be loaded. Check if the ANPR service is running and the MJPEG port (service port + 1) is reachable.
anpr.testFileLabel: Upload image or video for testing
anpr.streamNotReachable: Camera not reachable. Check if ffmpeg is installed and the RTSP URL is correct.
anpr.ignoreMarginHelp: Percentage of left/right border to exclude from OCR — for permanently visible signs or objects
anpr.minPlateHeightPx_help: Plates smaller than this value are ignored (too far away). 0 = disabled. Typical: 15–30px.
anpr.motionSizePct_help: Minimum plate area growth (%) to count as movement. Lower = more sensitive, higher = fewer false positives. Default: 20%.
anpr.openOrderSkip: Skip vehicles with open work orders
anpr.openOrderSkip_help: When active: vehicles with an ongoing workshop order are not shown in the info bar and do not open the gate. Default: disabled (all vehicles are shown).
anpr.healthNoData: No data yet — the service writes heartbeats after the first start
anpr.sudoInfo: Installing {pkg} requires the password of user {user}.
anpr.sudoHint: The password is used only for this operation and is never stored.
anpr.userMismatch: Service is running as a different user than configured ({configured}) — service file may not have been reloaded
anpr.debugRecvQWarning: TCP buffer stall! Check frame reader thread.
anpr.debugNoRtsp: No RTSP connections found (or missing ss permissions)
